agreement: A1g: 18 peaks from 8 papers, median 513.5 cm-1 (10-90% range 506.5-517.0)
A1g+B1g(2): 161 peaks from 76 papers, median 515.1 cm-1 (10-90% range 511.0-520.0)
B1g(1): 197 peaks from 89 papers, median 396.0 cm-1 (10-90% range 391.3-400.0)
B1g(2): 19 peaks from 8 papers, median 519.0 cm-1 (10-90% range 511.2-522.0)
Eg(1): 509 peaks from 95 papers, median 144.9 cm-1 (10-90% range 141.8-151.0)
Eg(2): 124 peaks from 63 papers, median 197.0 cm-1 (10-90% range 194.4-200.9)
Eg(3): 204 peaks from 89 papers, median 638.0 cm-1 (10-90% range 630.2-640.5)
conflicts: Order of the A1g/B1g(2) pair near 513/519 is disputed: Ohsaka 1978 puts A1g lower (used as this dataset's labelling convention); polarized single-crystal work (Giarola 2010, ANA068) puts A1g higher. Paper labels are kept in notes.
ANA034 reports every mode 8-13 cm-1 below the usual positions; ANA080 and ANA097 are 3-7 cm-1 low (copied as printed).
ANA032 deposited furnace spectra read 3-10 cm-1 low (calibration).
ANA005 re-analyses literature data that overlap ANA001 (flagged 'same data as').
missing: ANA088 has no spontaneous-Raman peaks (only 2D-correlation values) and needs a replacement paper.
No open-access in situ high-pressure or 18O-isotope anatase Raman paper was found (APS/ACS/RSC paywalls).
Round-2 papers (ANA034-ANA100) have extractor self-checks but no independent review sample yet.

confounders: crystallite size (phonon confinement: Eg(1) shifts up and broadens)
Si substrate line at 520.7 on the 513-519 doublet

(2012) Raman generation of coherent phonons of anatase and rutile TiO2 photoexcited at fundamental absorption edges. Physical Review B 86, 205201.), checked number by number (Qiaomu/data/mode_card_sources/CHECK.md); human teammate sign-off pending.
studies hold every collected paper: 99 papers, 1268 peaks, extracted by the rules in scripts/EXTRACTION_PROTOCOL.md.
training_eligible is false for unassigned peaks, artifacts and digitized-from-plot values.
Mode names (Eg(1), A1g+B1g(2), ...) match the mode_label column of peaks/anatase_peaks.csv.
Sources were found with OpenAlex, Europe PMC, Crossref and web search; Valency was blocked by organization policy.
Positions are copied from the source paper. Table I prints half widths (HWHM); FWHM = 2 x HWHM.

The A1g and B1g(2) components are not resolved in the source, so their separate positions are left empty. When a spectrum resolves them, this project labels the lower-frequency line A1g and the higher one B1g(2) (Ohsaka et al. 1978 convention). The order is disputed: polarized single-crystal work by Giarola et al. 2010 (ANA068) assigns A1g to the higher line.
Eg(1) shifts up and broadens in nanocrystals (phonon confinement) and with doping; the project's anatase papers show Eg(1) from about 137 to 159 cm-1.
